blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The grounding of passenger vessel M/V Roromaster 5 has raised concerns over its impact on a marine protected area (MPA) in the town of Abra de Ilog, including a core conservation zone, local disaster officials said Thursday evening The roll-on, roll-off vessel struck the seabed and was beached near Sitio Sigman, Barangay Udalo, after midnight, with all 117 passengers and crew members able to disembark and continue to their respective destinations, according to the municipal disaster office. According to the Abra de Ilog Emergency Response Operations (AERO), the vessel was grounded at the Munting Buhangin Marine Protected Area, which […]...
